RecorderManager.onError(function listener)

Listen to recording error events. If a status exception, operation exception, or system exception occurs during the operation of the recording manager, the recording manager will listen to errors(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Parameter

function listener

Listening function for recording error events

Parameters
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String Error information

Sample Code

Page({
    onload() {
        recorderManager.onError(() => {
            ma.showToast({
                title: 'onError',
                icon: 'success',
                duration: 500
            });
        });
    }
})
